parsed.note_claim: The Supreme Court ruled that the administration has the authority to end TPS under the statute.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Justice Samuel Alito said that the TPS statute bars any court review of how the president and his Department of Homeland Security have used their authority to end TPS status.
parsed.reason: The NPR article reports the 6-3 ruling that the president has unreviewable authority under the TPS law to end the program, directly substantiating the note's claim about the Court's ruling.
